rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for an exaggerated statement or an instance of overstatement.

example.english: Saying he finished ten kilometres in a minute is simply hyperbole.
example.traditional: 佢話自己一分鐘跑完十公里，根本係誇張嘅講法。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 jat1 fan1 zung1 paau2 jyun4 sap6 gung1 lei5 gan1 bun2 hai6 kwaa1 zoeng1 ge3 gong2 faat3

rows.note: Use this colloquial, dismissive word when the exaggeration is being treated as boastful or untrue rather than described neutrally.

example.english: His claim that he can finish all the food at a banquet by himself is pure hyperbole.
example.traditional: 佢話自己一個人食得晒成圍菜，完全係吹水。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 sik6 dak1 saai3 sing4 wai4 coi3 jyun4 cyun4 hai6 ceoi1 seoi2
